faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: The passing score for the Qlik Sense Business Analyst Certification exam is 62%. Please note that this passing percentage may be adjusted periodically to maintain a consistent global standard across test takers.

The examination duration is 120 minutes in total. Candidates should pace themselves carefully across all 50 questions and utilize the review feature for any flagged items before submitting their final answers.

editorial.overview: The Qlik Sense Business Analyst Certification is a formal evaluation designed to thoroughly test your ability to correctly identify business requirements, design functional applications, prepare and load data, and develop engaging applications. Certified by Qlik, this platform-neutral examination covers practical content applicable to both client-managed environments and Qlik Cloud deployments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review all relevant topics under creating apps and visualizations within the online help documentation. Practice building complete applications, constructing data models using Data Manager, and managing master items effectively. Check with Qlik for the official learning path and use the available preparation questions to accurately gauge your readiness.
skills_summary: Prepare, load, and manage data models
editorial.who_should_take: Business analysts and developers with practical experience building production-quality applications in Qlik Sense. Candidates should know how to create dimensions, measures, master library items, and understand user experience design best practices.
